titulo: Casa de México in Madrid unveils 2026 Day of the Dead altar inspired by Michoacán and Agustín Lara
cuerpo: Casa de México in Madrid unveils "Viva la vida!", its 2026 Day of the Dead altar honouring Agustín Lara, inspired by Michoacán and the monarch butterfly, with a musical tour. Free entry from 2 October to 8 November.
